draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base holds on the unseen test sets of the Banking and Travel domains (93.1 vs 91.6 and 92.4 vs 90.9 macro-F1).
rationale: Evidence only covers unseen test utterances from the two trained domains (Banking, Travel); no evaluation on other customer-service domains. The claim's generalization to "domains not seen in training" is unsupported. A narrower claim about the unseen test sets is supported.
